title: Clean 1.0 baseline: no 0.7 traces in code, tests and docs
question: The owner states that the first public version is 1.0 and everything must be clean (M16). Which 0.7 traces does the plan remove, and where?

options.text: P3 removes 0.7 traces from code, tests and docs: every since: '0.7' becomes '1.0'; tests/Fixtures/Baseline070 and tests/Regression/Baseline070 become current-format snapshots under Formats names without 0.7.0-only inventories (0.7.0 api-manifest byte copies, scopes-discovery and azg_ grant-field inventories, serializable-fqcn 0.7 targets); docs stop calling 0.7.0 the first public release. P4 sets version metadata (branch aliases, root requires) for the candidate. docs/upgrade.md 'From 0.7 to 1.0' stays as the owner-requested AI-agent instruction (M14).
Leave 0.7 markers until the P4 freeze.

context: P3 design session 2026-10-13, owner message «мы исходим из того, что публичная версия будет 1.0, поэтому все должно быть чисто». knowledge/contracts#rules prescribed since: '0.7' for unchanged 0.7.0 types; 253 production files carry it.
decision: A — P3 removes 0.7 traces from code, tests and docs: every since: '0.7' becomes '1.0'; tests/Fixtures/Baseline070 and tests/Regression/Baseline070 become current-format snapshots under Formats names without 0.7.0-only inventories (0.7.0 api-manifest byte copies, scopes-discovery and azg_ grant-field inventories, serializable-fqcn 0.7 targets); docs stop calling 0.7.0 the first public release. P4 sets version metadata (branch aliases, root requires) for the candidate. docs/upgrade.md 'From 0.7 to 1.0' stays as the owner-requested AI-agent instruction (M14).
rationale: Owner M16: «публичная версия будет 1.0, поэтому все должно быть чисто»; agent placed the cleanup in P3 and version metadata in P4.
consequences: D14's byte copies of the 0.7.0 manifests and sha256 pins are retired together with the copies.
Snapshot tests keep pinning current formats (I17) under neutral names; tests/zones.json and tests/README.md follow the rename.
Open for the owner: whether docs/upgrade.md 'From 0.7 to 1.0' ships in the public docs or moves to an internal location (default: stays, M14).
